create.name: Thea Willette
create.bio:
Thea Willette is a certified Quantum-Touch practitioner and Level 1 instructor, and one of the method's brand ambassadors, based in Ottawa, Ontario. She is also a certified meditation teacher. Her route into energy work began during a demanding period of her life, when she was working in a clinic for women as a sonographer, and describes the first time she felt life-force energy moving through her hands as a turning point.

Her one-to-one sessions last thirty minutes and are given live or by email: for the email format she runs the session at a time of her choosing and then sends a written account of what she noticed and which techniques she used. She teaches the fourteen-hour Becoming Energized (Level 1) workshop live on Zoom for students around the world, and also in person, covering the breathing and sweeping techniques, chakra work, toning and distance healing, with plenty of practice between classmates. On YouTube she hosts Quantum Conversations, a long-form interview series with Quantum-Touch founder Richard Gordon and with fellow practitioners and instructors, alongside talks on intuition, manifestation and abundance. She also mentors practitioners who want to deepen their own energy work, and offers guided meditation series by email.
